concerns.text: Task T024 aggregates predictor p‑values into a table with columns `{outcome, predictor, p_value}` but the contract `contracts/aggregated_pvalues.schema.yaml` requires an additional `threshold` field. The plan does not specify that this column will be produced, creating a mismatch that will cause schema validation to fail.

Task T025 applies the Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction but does not include a step that validates the resulting `aggregated_pvalues.parquet` (or its post‑correction version) against its schema. Without an explicit validation step, the pipeline may produce an artifact that does not conform to `aggregated_pvalues.schema.yaml`.
